reserveReview.rationale: At Hedera mainnet EVM block 100587413 (hash 0xec92fa0f98bb5c22bef164aee2d36ed1202d776698facee3d7ba430a40ba77d3; 2026-10-01 07:20:31 UTC), getETH() returned 2,379,004.38950113 HBAR for ActivePool 0.0.6070027, 0 for DefaultPool 0.0.6070041, and 230,312.76723166 HBAR for StabilityPool 0.0.6070108. Same-block getHCHFDebt() reads succeeded for ActivePool and DefaultPool, and getTotalHCHFDeposits() succeeded for StabilityPool. Current token metadata and HCHFToken immutable getter reads confirm the unchanged deployment identity. Official documentation and the protocol audit identify HBAR as the sole collateral asset; the full 100% slice remains HBAR collateral in protocol pools, without asserting any fiat reserve or collateral coverage ratio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: HLiquity single-collateral HBAR CDP design and same-block Hedera mainnet state reads from ActivePool, DefaultPool, and StabilityPool
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; current protocol state shows HBAR collateral in the named pools and HCHF debt/deposits. Per-Trove collateral ratios vary by user, liquidation state can move HBAR between pools, and aggregate coverage floats with the HBAR price.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Hedera block 100587413 on 2026-10-01, ActivePool, DefaultPool, and StabilityPool returned owner() = 0 and current HBAR balances were read through getETH(). Collateral is held in protocol pools, with per-user Trove accounting, rather than by an identified bank or off-chain custodian. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation protections remain unknown; the on-chain custody review does not establish legal safeguards.
